result.title: A Night at the LLM Zoo: Data Conditioned Flow Matching for Generating Pretrained LLM Weights
result.summary: A challenge to Weight Space Learning as it expands from task specific and vision models to Large Language Models (LLMs) is the absence of a well curated and analyzed LLM population. To address this, we train such a model zoo for application to Weight Space Generation by systematically varying the data mixture composition between web text, books, mathematics, coding, and French across populations of 51M, 124M, and 355M parameter GPT-2 Models, each tier with count N = 100. We analyze these populations by cosine similarity, functional diversity, Leave-One-Mixture-Out modeling, and variance decomposition. We show that the zoo contains diverse models whose variation is structured by training mixture composition. We embed the training mixture composition to condition a Flow Matching model of complete pretrained LLM weights in Gram-PCA compressed weight space. By demonstrating zero-shot generalization to held out mixtures, measuring Continuous Ranked Probability Score skill, as well as finding minimal changes in downstream test-set perplexity and general capability benchmark scores, we show that our generator generalizes on the simplex of data mixtures to produce models that perform similarly to those in the zoo ex nihilo. Finally, we produce all source code and artifacts to support the continued expansion of Weight Space Learning and Generation into the LLM domain.

AI.brief_summary: 论文系统改变网页文本、书籍、数学、代码与法语的混合比例，训练了 51M/124M/355M 三档、每档 100 个 GPT-2 模型构成权重动物园，分析其参数空间结构，并以数据混合嵌入为条件，在 Gram-PCA 压缩权重空间中用 Flow Matching 生成完整预训练权重。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以连续条件嵌入驱动 flow matching 在压缩子空间中采样整体参数」的建模方式，可能与 LVR 中按输入条件生成或初始化 latent 推理状态的参数化思路有方法类比，但条件对象是数据配比而非视觉证据，可供核查。
